info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Expires-v3-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Management API enables businesses to efficiently monitor and manage the expiration of loyalty program points. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of loyalty points that are nearing expiration, helping organizations proactively reach out to customers. It is essential for marketing teams aiming to engage customers before they lose their hard-earned rewards. Regular use of this API can enhance customer retention strategies and improve overall satisfaction by facilitating timely communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details regarding the expiration of loyalty points. It provides essential information that helps users understand their loyalty points’ validity and expiration dates.

requestBody.description: The request body for expiring loyalty account details. This body is used to specify the necessary parameters for the expiration of a loyalty account.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the expiration details of loyalty points.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyExpiresRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loyalty expiration. It is expected to be a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the operation status.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyExpiresResponse_200.description: Response schema for operations related to loyalty expiration. This schema contains details about the operation's status, reference information, processing time, and audit data.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information associated with the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This helps in understanding the performance of the request handling.
